checks.name: all methods, ablations and reported numerical results
checks.evidence: Only components listed in the claim mapping exist; no clinical or benchmark results were produced.

checks.name: 4500 substantive code lines
checks.evidence: The delivered subset does not meet the requested minimum; padding or unsubstantiated implementations were not added.

checks.name: lint, strict type check, distributed training and container build
checks.evidence: Full project infrastructure is not implemented.

checks.name: HEST HCC real matched patches and sparse expression
checks.evidence: NCBI642: 1941 image barcodes matched, independent raw expression and coordinate check for one row; image shape 224x224x3. First 2000 file-order genes were used solely for this validation and are not a reported HVG selection.

checks.name: HEST patch-size safeguard
checks.evidence: The real 224-pixel file was rejected under the 256-pixel default and loaded when 224 was explicitly requested.

checks.name: HEST HCC benchmark split format
checks.evidence: Fold-0 train and test split files parsed successfully; 1 sample in each. Sample-to-patient mapping was not available, so patient-level separation was not established.

checks.name: TCGA-LIHC real GDC case metadata
checks.evidence: 25 cases parsed; 20 had stage and all 25 had vital status. No treatment-response labels inferred.

checks.name: EGA and CODEX end-to-end data processing
checks.evidence: EGA requires controlled access; CODEX image registration and the processed cell phenotype table were not available or validated.

checks.name: paper-compatible HEST images and CONCH features
checks.evidence: Current validated HEST images are 224 pixels, while the manuscript specifies 256; CONCH weights and matching 256-pixel features were unavailable.

checks.name: end-to-end training with manuscript inputs
checks.evidence: Verified CONCH features, manuscript-sized images, and the reported cohort partitions are unavailable.

scientific_uncertainties: Pretraining specifies batch 128 but also 32 per GPU, four accumulation steps and four GPUs; a conventional global accumulated batch would be 512.
Neighbour mean and variance, spot and slide features constitute four d-dimensional blocks, while the manuscript says 3d; the code explicitly uses four.
The manuscript reports several baseline numbers estimated from published relative performance, so they are not evidence of independent runs on the stated cohorts.
No officially released VL-INM repository or weights are identified in the supplied manuscript; CONCH is a separate upstream model.
Actual patient splits, preprocessing details, complete hyperparameters and paired data provenance were not established.
The HEST source card license differs from the manuscript license statement.
dataset_link_validation: Official catalogue and two HEST HCC benchmark sample files and split metadata accessed. GDC API returned actual case records. EGA controlled files and full CODEX data were not accessed.
paper_source: Supplied manuscript, 36 pages; supplementary information included within the PDF.
execution: Real-data reading and barcode matching were checked on CPU. Full manuscript training has not been conducted.
